fee_notes: Standard Territory: $54,900; Micro-Territory: $38,500. 10% discount available for veterans (discharged within 10 years) and first responders (retired within 10 years). Initial Technology Set Up Fee: $1,000 (non-refundable). Installation equipment and materials via affiliate VHPC: ~$23,500 (refundable less 25% restocking fee).
raw_excerpt: The initial franchise fee for a new franchise is $54,900 per territory (Standard Territory) or $38,500 per territory (Micro-Territory). We offer a 10% discount on the initial franchise fee for a Veteran honorably discharged from any branch of the U.S. armed forces within ten (10) years of applying for a franchise with us. We offer a 10% discount on the initial franchise fee for a first responder that has retired within ten (10) years of applying for a franchise with us.
